method: Transcribed the Google Trends Explore rendered chart tables via the browser DOM. CSV files are not native Google exports. Account UI and screenshots are retained privately and are not published.
limitations: Normalized, sampled relative interest from 0 to 100; not monthly search counts, ranking difficulty, revenue or purchase intent.
Compare indices only within the same chart. Do not compare changes to 24 October as growth; windows, samples and normalization differ.
The latest week may be incomplete. A displayed zero does not establish zero searches.
English query wording is not an English-language audience filter. AI audit includes multiple search intents.
Broad AI-agent interest informs a relevant educational entry point, not a generic agent product or ranking claim.

Search Console was read separately through the authorized work account. Private account metrics and screenshots are not included in this public evidence. Field Core Web Vitals showed no data; no measured ranking, traffic or Core Web Vitals improvement is asserted.
